title: Agent Identity Protocol attestation source document
description: The attestation source document served at the discovery `attestation.uri` in both modes. Frozen shape: { "attestation": "<compact JWS>" } with Content-Type application/json. Additional fields are ignored by conformant clients; producers should not add private, agent, or human data. A raw JWT body is not accepted. The JWS is a Contract G `agent-rp-attestation+jwt` whose format is unchanged. Normative definition: agent-identity-protocol.md §14. Kept in lockstep with `AttestationSourceDocumentSchema` in this package (Zod is the source of truth).

attestation.description: The compact Contract G attestation JWS (`typ: agent-rp-attestation+jwt`). The client verifies it against the issuer JWKS; it never treats this string as trusted input.
